credible_backlog.body:

- Acrostic #2 (spelling BOUNTY) at line 20 is entirely missing — needs a full 6-line poem about treasure hunting, each line ~8-10 syllables, first letters must spell B-O-U-N-T-Y
- Acrostic #3 is complete and should not be modified

- Each line fits the theme and syllable count specified in the TODO
- Acrostic #3 remains unchanged

credible_backlog.title: [ English ] Complete missing lines in limericks.md — finish three limericks
credible_backlog.body:
Complete three unfinished limericks in english/limericks.md

- "The Programmer" at line 13: missing closing line (line 5) — must rhyme with "Rust" and "dust", maintain AABBA limerick scheme
- "The Coffee" at lines 31-32: missing lines 3 and 4 — each ~5 syllables, must rhyme with each other (the B-B pair in AABBA), set up the punchline for the existing closing line
- "The Astronaut" at line 43: missing closing line (line 5) — must rhyme with "stars" and "Mars", provide a humorous conclusion

- All TODO placeholders in limericks.md are replaced with actual limerick lines
- Each limerick follows AABBA rhyme scheme
- Lines 3-4 in each limerick are shorter (~5-7 syllables) than lines 1,2,5 (~8-10 syllables) per standard limerick meter
- "The Cat" limerick remains unchanged
- Rhymes are exact, not slant rhymes
